**Cau tra loi ngan: `onnxruntime-gpu` KHONG dung duoc.** Day la cau hoi rat tu nhien
(VieNeu mac dinh chay ONNX) nhung bang chung tu ma nguon goi noi khac:

`vieneu/_v3_turbo_engine/onnx_runtime_lite.py`:
    prov = ["CPUExecutionProvider"]        <-- GHI CUNG
Engine ONNX khong nhan tham so provider nao.

`vieneu/v3turbo.py` — chinh tac gia ghi trong chu thich:
    backend: str = "auto"   # "auto" → ONNX on CPU, PyTorch on GPU
    use_onnx = backend == "onnx" or (backend == "auto" and dev_type == "cpu")

=> **GPU buoc di duong PyTorch.** Ngoai ra `onnxruntime-gpu` dung CUNG ten module voi
`onnxruntime` ban CPU nen cai chung se thay the no, anh huong ca fastembed.

**Duong PyTorch can gi:** doi chieu import trong `_v3_turbo_engine/`:
    torch, torchaudio, transformers, safetensors

## [3.23.338] — 🔴 Sua loi "WhisperX thoat ma 2" — lai la mot cho TOI BO SOT

### Nguyen nhan chinh xac
Adapter goi worker o HAI cho:
    dong 238  (phien am)   -> da sua o v3.23.333, dung resolve_whisperx_python()
    dong 378  (can chinh)  -> **VAN dung sys.executable** — toi bo sot
O ban DONG GOI, `sys.executable` chinh la tep `.exe` cua ung dung. Chay no voi
`--mode align --audio ... --config ...` thi app khong hieu tham so -> argparse tra
**ma 2**. Do dung con so ban thay tren man hinh.

Day la lan thu BA trong cac ban gan day toi mac cung mot kieu loi: **sua mot cho roi
tuong da xong, khong tim het cac cho khac** (v3.23.335 voi dependency_doctor,
v3.23.337 voi khoi batch cu, va nay).

### 🔴 Loi thu hai tim duoc trong luc sua: torch/lib tro nham moi truong
`_build_subprocess_env()` suy duong dan `torch\\lib` tu `sysconfig` cua TIEN TRINH
CHINH. Nhung tu v3.23.333 torch nam trong `whisperx_env`, khong con o moi truong chinh
-> khong tim thay gi -> buoc can chinh cap tu se thieu cuDNN va co the loi bo nho
(access violation 0xC0000005).
**Da sua:** suy tu chinh trinh thong dich se chay worker (`whisperx_env/Lib/site-packages/torch/lib`).

### 🔴 Loi thu ba: thong diep loi vo dung
"Tiến trình WhisperX thoát mã 2." khong noi duoc gi. Ma nguon CO co gang dung stderr
(`"; ".join(error_lines)`) nhung khi chay nham .exe thi stderr rong -> roi vao thong
diep du phong tran trui.
**Da sua:** ma 2 + khong co dong loi nao = dau hieu DAC TRUNG cua chay nham trinh thong
dich. Nay bao ro:
    WhisperX không chạy được: tiến trình con từ chối tham số (mã 2).
    Thường do chưa có môi trường riêng, nên ứng dụng chạy nhầm chính nó thay vì Python.
    Hãy bấm nút "⬇️ Cài WhisperX tự động" trong nhóm Giọng nói (STT), hoặc tạo thủ công:
      python -m venv whisperx_env
      whisperx_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip install torch torchaudio torchvision ^
          --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129
      whisperx_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip install whisperx

## [3.23.337] — 🔴 SU CO THAT: build_env cua ban DA BI HONG. Nguyen nhan la LOI CUA TOI.

### ⚠️ VIEC BAN CAN LAM NGAY
Log build cho thay `build_env` hien dang HONG:
    Uninstalling huggingface_hub-1.25.1 ... Successfully uninstalled
    Successfully installed huggingface-hub-0.36.2 tokenizers-0.22.2 torch-2.8.0 ...
    ERROR: gradio 6.20.0 requires huggingface-hub<2.0,>=1.2.0,
           but you have huggingface-hub 0.36.2 which is incompatible.
`huggingface-hub` bi HA CAP 1.25.1 -> 0.36.2 va `gradio` (VieNeu-TTS dung) da hong.

**Khac phuc:** xoa `build_env` roi build lai bang ban nay:
    rmdir /s /q build_env
    build_windows.bat
(Ban nay da sua nguyen nhan nen se khong tai dien.)

### 🔴 NGUYEN NHAN — loi cua toi o v3.23.333
Toi sua `build_windows.bat` bang phep thay chuoi, dung moc ket thuc:
    end = s.index(":skip_whisperx")
Nhung chuoi do **CUNG NAM TRONG** `goto :skip_whisperx` o DAU khoi. Nen `end` tro toi
ngay sau dong goto, khong phai nhan o cuoi. Ket qua: chi phan dau bi thay, **khoi cu
con nguyen ben duoi**:
    :skip_whisperx                                  <- nhan (het khoi moi)
    echo [INFO] cai WhisperX + torch...             <- khoi CU
    "%PYEXE%" -m pip install whisperx               <- cai vao MOI TRUONG CHINH
    :skip_whisperx                                  <- nhan TRUNG
Lenh cai nam SAU nhan nen moi nhanh `goto :skip_whisperx` deu roi thang vao no — chay
**VO DIEU KIEN**, ke ca khi tinh nang bi tat.

**Vi sao phep kiem cua toi khong bat duoc:** no chi xet (a) ngoac can bang,
(b) `goto` co nhan tuong ung. Nhan TRUNG van "co nhan" nen qua duoc; lenh cai lot luoi
thi khong co phep kiem nao.

### 🔴 LOI THU HAI: cong cu kiem xung dot BAO SACH du da hong
Log cho thay buoc kiem chay sau khi hong va van bao:
    ✓ Không có xung đột nào cần xử lý
Vi no chi hoi "cai goi X co xung dot khong" cho 6 goi tuy chon trong danh sach cung.
Sau khi pip DA ha cap, trang thai tro nen **tu nhat quan voi whisperx** (0.36.2 thoa man
`<1.0.0`) -> tra loi "khong xung dot". Thiet hai nam o goi KHAC (gradio) ma cong cu
khong he kiem.

**Da sua:** them `check_installed_consistency()` — quet NGUOC LAI: voi MOI goi dang cai,
rang buoc cua no co duoc thoa man khong (tuong duong `pip check`). Do tren trang thai
hong cua ban: bat duoc `gradio yeu cau huggingface-hub>=1.2.0 nhung dang cai 0.36.2` ✓
(truoc day bat 0).

### DA SUA — ba viec
1. **Xoa khoi cu + nhan trung** trong `build_windows.bat`. Xac minh: 0 lenh cai whisperx

## [3.23.336] — ⬇️ Nut "Cai WhisperX tu dong" ngay trong ung dung

### Ban yeu cau nut cai thay vi go lenh tay — da lam, va lam AN TOAN
Diem khac biet so voi nut cai CU (vua go o v3.23.335):
| | Nut cu (nguy hiem) | Nut moi (an toan) |
|---|---|---|
| Cai vao dau | moi truong CHINH (`sys.executable`) | moi truong RIENG `whisperx_env` |
| Hau qua | ha cap huggingface-hub 1.24 -> 0.x, hong VieNeu/PaddleOCR | khong dung toi moi truong chinh |
| torch | lay ban CPU tu PyPI | ban CUDA 12.9, khop paddle cu129 |

### Bon buoc cai (co bao tien do)
    1. Tao moi truong rieng…              (trong so 0.5)
    2. Nang cap pip…                      (0.5)
    3. Tai torch ban CUDA 12.9 (~3GB)…    (8.0 — lau nhat)
    4. Cai WhisperX…                      (1.0)
Trong so dat theo thoi gian THAT nen thanh tien do khong nhay vot roi dung im o buoc 3.

### 🛡️ BAT BIEN AN TOAN — co kiem tra cung trong ma nguon
`assert_targets_isolated_env()` chan moi lenh `pip install` KHONG tro vao
`whisperx_env`. Chay truoc TUNG buoc, khong phai chi kiem luc dung lenh.
Da thu: truyen lenh dung `sys.executable` -> bi tu choi ngay.

Ly do phai chan cung thay vi chi "viet dung": neu sau nay ai do sua ham dung lenh ma
so y, bat bien nay van chan duoc — chinh la loai sai lam da gay ra su co v3.23.335.

### Xu ly cac tinh huong that
- **Khong co Python tren may** (ban dong goi khong kem Python): bao ro "cai Python
  3.10–3.13 tu python.org, nho tick Add to PATH" thay vi loi cut.
- **Xac nhan truoc khi tai**: neu ro se tai ~3GB va "moi truong cua ung dung KHONG bi
  dung toi", de ban quyet dinh.
- **Chay nen** (QThread + QueuedConnection): tai 3GB khong khoa giao dien.
- **Cai xong dung duoc NGAY**: xoa cache kha dung roi lam moi trang, khong can mo lai app.
- Cai that bai -> hien 3 dong cuoi cua log pip de biet nguyen nhan.

### Test
`test_whisperx_installer_v323336.py` — 15 test, quan trong nhat:
- **Moi lenh install phai tro vao moi truong rieng** (bat bien chinh).
- **Tu choi lenh tro vao moi truong chinh** — tai hien dung su co cu.
- torch phai dung `--index-url .../cu129`, va phai cai TRUOC whisperx (nguoc lai pip
  se tu keo ban CPU tu PyPI).
- Duong dan moi truong khop giua trinh cai va adapter — lech la cai xong van bao chua co.
- Buoc torch phai co trong so lon nhat.
Tong: **471 test PASS** (truoc 456).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Ban can thu:
1. Mo tab "Giong noi (STT)" -> phai thay nut "⬇️ Cai WhisperX tu dong".
2. Bam -> xac nhan -> theo doi thanh tien do (buoc torch se lau nhat).
3. Cai xong -> nut phai TU AN va tinh nang phien am dung duoc NGAY (khong mo lai app).
4. **Quan trong**: sau khi cai, kiem moi truong chinh KHONG bi dung toi:
       build_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip show huggingface-hub
   Phai VAN la 1.x.

## [3.23.335] — 🔴 Sua thong diep WhisperX CU van hien tren man hinh + CHAN nut cai nguy hiem

### Ban gui anh man hinh — va no cho thay LOI CUA TOI o v3.23.333
Man hinh van hien:
    ⚠️ Chưa cài WhisperX — tính năng phiên âm tạm thời không dùng được.
    💡 pip install whisperx (cần torch + CUDA để chạy nhanh).

Do la thong diep CU. v3.23.333 toi doi WhisperX sang moi truong rieng va cap nhat thong
diep trong `whisperx_adapter.py` — nhung **BO SOT `dependency_doctor.py`**, chinh la noi
giao dien lay chu de hien. Toi sua mot cho roi tuong da xong, khong tim het cac noi khac.

**Hau qua that:** nguoi dung duoc khuyen lam DUNG CAI SE LAM HONG UNG DUNG
(`pip install whisperx` vao moi truong chinh -> ha cap huggingface-hub 1.24 -> 0.x).

### 🔴 Con nghiem trong hon: co NUT TU CAI goi nguy hiem
`check_whisperx()` tra ve `pip_args=("whisperx",)`, ma `install_package()` chay:
    [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", *pip_args]
`sys.executable` = moi truong CHINH. Nghia la giao dien co the co nut bam-mot-cai de
cai whisperx vao build_env — bam vao la hong VieNeu-TTS/PaddleOCR.

**Da sua ba diem:**
1. `check_whisperx()` nay goi `resolve_whisperx_python()` — kiem MOI TRUONG RIENG thay vi
   tien trinh hien tai. Truoc day tao `whisperx_env` xong VAN bi bao "chua cai".
2. **Bo han `pip_args`** -> khong con nut tu cai. Thay bang huong dan tao moi truong rieng.
3. **Chan cung trong `install_package()`**: tu choi whisperx/torch/torchaudio/torchvision
   du ai do goi thang, kem giai thich va goi y dung cach.

### Loi thu tu: cache ket qua AM
`is_stt_available()` cache ca ket qua am. Nghia la tao `whisperx_env` xong van bi bao
"chua cai" cho toi khi KHOI DONG LAI ung dung — de bi hieu nham la cai hong.
Nay **chi cache ket qua duong**; phep kiem khi chua co chi la vai lan thu duong dan nen
chay lai rat re.

### Thong diep moi (da kiem chung hien thi dung)
    ⚠️ Chưa có môi trường WhisperX — tính năng phiên âm chưa dùng được. WhisperX phải
       cài RIÊNG vì nó yêu cầu huggingface-hub < 1.0 trong khi ứng dụng dùng bản 1.x;
       cài chung sẽ làm hỏng VieNeu-TTS/PaddleOCR.
    💡 Chạy trong thư mục dự án:
         python -m venv whisperx_env
         whisperx_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip install torch torchaudio torchvision ^
             --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129
         whisperx_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip install whisperx
       Hoặc đặt biến SUBEXT_WHISPERX_PYTHON trỏ tới python.exe có WhisperX.

### Test chong hoi quy
`test_whisperx_diagnosis_v323335.py` — 13 test, trong do quan trong nhat:
- **Quet TOAN BO ma nguon**: chuoi cu "pip install whisperx (cần torch" khong duoc con
  o BAT KY dau. Day chinh la loai loi vua xay ra — sua mot cho, sot cho khac.
- Hai nguon thong diep (adapter + dependency_doctor) phai NHAT QUAN: cung nhac moi
  truong rieng, cung giai thich ly do huggingface-hub, cung dung index cu129.
- `pip_args` phai rong; `install_package` phai TU CHOI 4 goi nguy hiem.
- Tao moi truong rieng xong phai duoc nhan la SAN SANG ngay.
Tong: **456 test PASS** (truoc 443).

### Tu anh man hinh: nhung thu HOAT DONG DUNG
- Thanh tien do quy trinh hien dung o dau (v3.23.317) ✓
- Nut "Trich xuat hang loat…" co mat (v3.23.319) ✓
- Ba tab Chu chay (OCR) / Phu de nhung / Giong noi (STT) day du ✓
- Nhan dien video 1920x1080 @ 23.98fps, thoi luong 43:39 ✓

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
1. Chay lai app -> tab "Giong noi (STT)" phai hien thong diep MOI (nhac whisperx_env,
   khong con "pip install whisperx").
2. Tao `whisperx_env` theo huong dan -> quay lai tab do, phai bao san sang MA KHONG
   can khoi dong lai app.
3. Neu giao dien co nut tu cai WhisperX -> bam thu, phai bi TU CHOI kem giai thich.

## [3.23.334] — 🔍 Ra soat HE THONG xung dot phu thuoc — ket qua: chi whisperx

### Ban hoi: con thu vien nao xung dot tuong tu whisperx khong?
**Da kiem TAT CA. Ket qua: KHONG — chi mot minh whisperx.**

### Cach kiem: doc metadata that, danh gia dieu kien moi truong
Tai metadata cua 7 goi tuy chon roi doi chieu voi phien ban THAT trong build_env cua
ban (lay tu log build): numpy 2.3.5, huggingface-hub 1.24.0, onnxruntime 1.28.0,
scipy 1.18.0, pandas 3.0.5, pillow 12.3.0, tokenizers 0.23.1, aiohttp 3.14.3…

| Goi | Ket qua |
|---|---|
| edge-tts | ✓ khong xung dot |
| fastembed | ✓ khong xung dot |
| pedalboard | ✓ khong rang buoc goi nao dang cai |
| scikit-learn | ✓ khong xung dot |
| vieneu | ✓ khong xung dot |
| PySide6-Fluent-Widgets | ✓ khong rang buoc goi nao |
| **whisperx** | ⛔ huggingface-hub<1.0.0 vs dang cai 1.24.0 |

=> Chi whisperx, va no DA duoc co lap sang moi truong rieng o v3.23.333.

### ⚠️ MOT CAI BAY suyt lam toi ket luan sai
`fastembed` thoat nhin RAT giong xung dot:
    numpy (>=1.21,<2.3.0)                       <-- 2.3.5 vuot nguong?
    onnxruntime (>=1.17.0,!=1.20.0,<1.24)       <-- 1.28.0 vuot nguong?
Nhung doc NGUYEN VAN kem dieu kien:
    numpy (>=1.21,<2.3.0)  ; python_version == "3.10"
    numpy (>=1.26)         ; python_version == "3.12"   <-- ap dung cho build cua ban
build_env chay **Python 3.12** (log: `Python: 3.12.13`) nen chi dong thu hai co hieu
luc, va 2.3.5 thoa man. Ket luan bang mat se BAO DONG GIA.

### `tools/check_dependency_conflicts.py` (MOI)
Cong cu tai su dung duoc, KHONG doc bang mat:
- Doc `Requires-Dist` tu wheel, **danh gia marker** (`python_version`, `sys_platform`)
  theo dung moi truong dang chay -> khong bao dong gia.
- Bo qua rang buoc thuoc `extra` (chi cai khi yeu cau tuong minh).
- Biet goi nao CO Y cai rieng (`ISOLATED_PACKAGES`) de bao "co xung dot nhung khong
  anh huong" thay vi bao loi.
- Thong diep neu HE QUA: "pip se DOI PHIEN BAN goi nay", khong chi bao lech so.

Chay tay:
    python tools/check_dependency_conflicts.py
    python tools/check_dependency_conflicts.py whisperx pedalboard

### Da them vao build script (Buoc 3b)
Chay TRUOC khi build, chi canh bao chu khong chan. Ly do phai tu dong: loi kieu nay
**hong am tham** — paddlex/vieneu khong rang buoc phien ban huggingface-hub nen pip ha
cap ma khong bao gi, den luc phat hien thi rat kho lan ra nguyen nhan.

### ⚠️ LUU Y QUAN TRONG khi doc ket qua
Cong cu kiem MOI TRUONG DANG CHAY. Chay trong container cua toi cho ket qua
"whisperx khong xung dot" — vi container KHONG cai huggingface-hub nen khong co gi de
xung dot. Phai chay bang `build_env\\Scripts\\python.exe` moi co y nghia. Buoc 3b trong
build script dung dung `%PYEXE%` nen se cho ket qua that.

### Test
`test_dependency_conflicts_v323334.py` — 22 test: chuan hoa ten goi (5 dang viet),
**tai hien dung xung dot whisperx da xay ra**, thong diep neu he qua, bat 4 kieu rang
buoc vi pham, KHONG bao dong gia voi 4 rang buoc thoa man, **marker cua Python khac
khong tinh la xung dot** (cho de sai nhat), bo qua `extra`, goi chua cai, rang buoc
rong, dong hong khong lam sap, danh sach goi cai rieng, va build script phai goi cong cu.
Tong: **443 test PASS** (truoc 421).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
1. Chay `build_env\\Scripts\\python.exe tools\\check_dependency_conflicts.py`
   -> phai bao 6 goi sach, rieng whisperx bao "co xung dot nhung CAI RIENG".
2. Build lai -> Buoc 3b phai chay va in bao cao truoc khi vao PyInstaller.
3. Sau khi cai whisperx_env, kiem lai:
       build_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip show huggingface-hub
   Phai VAN la 1.x (moi truong rieng khong dung toi build_env).

## [3.23.333] — 🎤 WhisperX: cai vao MOI TRUONG RIENG de tranh XUNG DOT PHU THUOC

### 🔴 PHAT HIEN QUAN TRONG: cai chung se LAM HONG ung dung
Tra metadata that cua `whisperx 3.8.6`:
    torch~=2.8.0, torchaudio~=2.8.0, torchvision~=0.23.0
    **huggingface-hub<1.0.0**      <-- VAN DE
    ctranslate2, faster-whisper, pyannote-audio, transformers, nltk, omegaconf...

Log build cua ban cho thay ung dung dang dung **huggingface-hub 1.24.0**. Neu cai
whisperx chung vao `build_env`, pip se **HA CAP huggingface-hub tu 1.24 xuong 0.x** —
doi phien ban LON co thay doi API. Ca VieNeu-TTS lan PaddleOCR deu dung goi nay de tai
mo hinh, nen rui ro lam hong ca hai.

Da kiem: paddlex/paddleocr/vieneu KHONG rang buoc phien ban huggingface-hub, nghia la
pip se cho phep ha cap ma khong bao loi — hong am tham, kho lan ra nguyen nhan.

### Buoc cai CU trong build script la SAI
    "%PYEXE%" -m pip install whisperx        <-- cai chung + lay torch CPU tu PyPI
Hai loi: (a) cai chung -> ha cap huggingface-hub; (b) khong chi dinh index nen lay
torch **CPU**, WhisperX se khong dung duoc GPU.

### DA SUA: moi truong Python RIENG `whisperx_env`
Build script nay tao venv rieng va cai dung ban CUDA khop paddle (cu129):
    python -m venv whisperx_env
    whisperx_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip install torch torchaudio torchvision ^
        --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129
    whisperx_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip install whisperx

Giai quyet BA van de cung luc:
1. **Xung dot phu thuoc** — huggingface-hub cua app giu nguyen 1.24.
2. **Xung dot DLL** — torch nap CUDA rieng, khong dung paddle (adapter von da chay
   subprocess chinh vi ly do nay).
3. **Dung luong** — khong phinh bundle them ~3GB.

### Adapter: bo `sys.executable`, tim moi truong rieng
`resolve_whisperx_python()` tim theo thu tu:
    1. Bien SUBEXT_WHISPERX_PYTHON (tro thang toi python.exe bat ky)
    2. Thu muc `whisperx_env/` canh du an
    3. sys.executable — CHI khi chay tu ma nguon VA that su co whisperx
Truoc day dung thang `sys.executable`, gay ba van de: buoc cai chung (xung dot),
va o **ban dong goi thi `sys.executable` chinh la tep .exe** — chay no se mo lai ung
dung chu khong chay script.

`is_available()` nay = "tim duoc moi truong co WhisperX", khong con la "co whisperx
trong tien trinh nay" — dung voi thiet ke moi truong rieng.

### Thong diep huong dan thay vi bao loi cut
Truoc: "Chua cai WhisperX. Cai bang: pip install whisperx (can torch + CUDA)."
(Lam theo dung cau nay se HONG ung dung nhu phan tich o tren.)
Nay: neu ro VI SAO phai cai rieng + lenh copy-paste chay duoc ngay, kem dung index cu129.

### spec: LUON loai whisperx/torch khoi bundle
Truoc day bat SUBEXT_ENABLE_WHISPERX=1 thi spec se GOM torch vao bundle — mau thuan voi
thiet ke moi truong rieng. Nay luon loai; bat co chi de build script tao venv rieng.

### 🛡️ Bo canh giu tinh lai bat duoc mot loi cua toi
Sau khi xoa khoi gom torch, bien `_WHISPERX_ENABLED` bi xoa nhung dong 372 VAN dung ->
`NameError` lam **hong ca build**, dung loai loi da xay ra o v3.23.323. Phep kiem AST
bat duoc ngay truoc khi dong goi.

### Test
`test_whisperx_env_v323333.py` — 12 test: uu tien bien moi truong, bo qua bien tro tep
khong ton tai / chuoi rong, tra None khi khong co gi, **ban dong goi khong bao gio dung
sys.executable**, ten thu muc khop giua adapter va build script, thong diep phai giai
thich ly do + chua dung lenh cai + dung index cu129, va spec LUON loai torch.
Tong: **421 test PASS** (truoc 409).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
1. `set SUBEXT_ENABLE_WHISPERX=1` roi chay `build_windows.bat` -> phai tao thu muc
   `whisperx_env` va cai torch tu index cu129 (log se hien "download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129").
2. Kiem `build_env` KHONG bi ha cap huggingface-hub:
       build_env\\Scripts\\python -m pip show huggingface-hub
   Phai van la 1.x.
3. Mo trang Trich xuat -> chuc nang "Phien am giong noi" phai hien khả dụng.
4. Chua cai -> bam vao phai thay huong dan cai day du thay vi loi cut.

## [3.23.332] — 🌐 DICH HANG LOAT: hoan tat phu song ca 4 khau tu dong hoa duoc

### Vi sao khau nay KHAC HAN ba khau truoc
Trich xuat / TTS / Xuat ban chay CUC BO nen cu chay toi het. Dich goi **dich vu ngoai
co han muc NGAY (RPD)**. Tra tu `gemini_quota_manager` (API that):
    gemini-3.1-flash-lite -> RPD 500
    gemini-2.5-flash-lite -> RPD 20
    gemini-2.5-flash/pro  -> RPD 20
Voi bo 84 tap, neu dung mo hinh RPD 20 thi het han muc gan nhu ngay lap tuc.

Nen ke hoach dich hang loat phai lam ba viec ma cac khau kia khong can:

**1. UOC LUONG so request TRUOC khi chay**
Doc so cau THAT tu tung tep phu de goc (khong doan), chia theo kich thuoc lo dang dat.
Do tren bo 84 tap x 45 cau:
    lo  20 cau -> 252 request
    lo  40 cau -> 168 request
    lo 100 cau ->  84 request
Canh bao neu vuot han muc: "Uoc tinh can 168 request nhung han muc ngay cua mo hinh
dang chon chi 20. Lo se dung giua chung khi het han muc — cac tap da dich xong van
duoc giu, chay lai hom sau se tu bo qua chung."

**2. DUNG EM khi het han muc — khong dot loi cho cac tap con lai**
Diem quan trong nhat. Neu cu chay tiep sau khi het han muc thi 72 tap con lai deu that
bai, vua ton thoi gian vua lam bao cao vo nghia.
`_on_error_for_batch()` nhan dien loi han muc (`hạn mức` / `quota` / `rpd` /
`resource_exhausted`) -> dung HAN hang doi va bao rieng:
    "HET HAN MUC NGAY. Da dich xong 10/84 tap. Con 73 tap chua dich — chay lai vao
     ngay mai, he thong se TU BO QUA cac tap da xong nen khong ton them han muc."
Loi THUONG (timeout mang...) van chay tiep binh thuong — da kiem chung tach bach duoc.

**3. Chay lai hom sau khong ton them han muc**
`skip_existing` quet `*.translate.*.srt`. Do thuc te: 20 tap, 11 tap da dich hom qua
-> lan chay sau chi con 9 tap can dich ✓

### Kien truc
`batch_translate_plan.py` (THUAN, testable):
- `count_subtitle_lines()` — dem cau that (SRT dem dong `-->`, ASS dem `Dialogue:`).
- `find_source_subtitle()` / `find_existing_translation()` — quet mau, khong doan ma
  ngon ngu (bai hoc v3.23.323).
- `estimate_requests()` / `quota_warning()` — phan biet duoc "khong ro han muc" (khong
  canh bao) voi "vuot han muc" (canh bao).

### Test
`test_batch_translate_plan_v323332.py` — 24 test: dem cau SRT/ASS/tep hong, tim tep,
phan loai 3 trang thai, chi tap san sang moi chay, uoc luong theo kich thuoc lo,
kich thuoc lo = 0 khong gay chia cho 0, canh bao han muc (vuot / trong han / khong ro),
va **kiem tren bo 84 tap that**: 168 request, vua RPD 500 nhung vuot RPD 20.
Tong: **409 test PASS** (truoc 385).

### 🏁 TIEN DO PHU SONG HANG LOAT — HOAN TAT
| Khau | Trang thai |
|---|---|
| Trich xuat | ✅ v3.23.319 (+ huy dung v3.23.328) |
| Bien tap | ⏸️ CO Y khong tu dong — day la khau nguoi doc soat chat luong |
| Dich | ✅ **ban nay** |
| TTS | ✅ v3.23.330 + v3.23.331 |
| Xuat ban | ✅ v3.23.329 |
=> **4/4 khau tu dong hoa duoc da xong.** Voi bo 84 tap, quy trinh gio la: chay hang

## [3.23.331] — 🎙️ Noi giao dien TTS hang loat (hoan thanh phan hoan lai o v3.23.330)

v3.23.330 toi lam xong phan LAP KE HOACH nhung hoan phan giao dien vi trang TTS phuc
tap (1700+ dong, nhieu engine, worker rieng, nap mo hinh bat dong bo). Ban nay noi xong,
lam can than tung diem moc.

### Nut "🎞️ Tong hop ca bo…"
Dat canh nut "Tong hop tieng noi". Luong:
1. Chon THU MUC chua cac tap.
2. Tu do video nguon + tim ban dich cua tung tap.
3. Hien ke hoach + **uoc tinh thoi gian**: "12 tap se tong hop · 3 chua dich · 2 da co
   — uoc tinh khoang 12 phut. Mo hinh chi nap mot lan cho ca hang doi."
4. Chay lan luot voi cung engine va thiet lap dang dat.

### Ba diem moc noi vao trang (cho tung buoc bat dong bo)
| Tin hieu | Khi chay hang loat | Khi dung binh thuong |
|---|---|---|
| `source_changed` | nap xong -> TU BAM "Tong hop" | chi cap nhat nhan |
| `result_ready` | luu du an roi sang tap ke, KHONG hien hop thoai | hien "TTS hoan tat" |
| `error_occurred` | ghi nhan tap loi roi CHAY TIEP | hien canh bao, dung |

**Diem quan trong:** nap phu de la thao tac BAT DONG BO, nen phai dung co
`_batch_pending_generate` de biet lan `source_changed` nay la cua hang doi hay do nguoi
dung tu bam "Nap SRT/ASS". Khong co co nay thi nap tay cung se tu dong chay TTS — pha
hanh vi cu. Da kiem chung truong hop nay (kich ban 5).

### Huy dung ca hang doi
Giong loi da sua o v3.23.328 cho trich xuat: nut Huy truoc day chi dung tap hien tai.
Nay bam Huy khi dang chay ca bo -> dung han, bao "bo N tap con lai".

### Kiem chung 5 kich ban (mo phong dung luong dieu phoi)
    chay het 8 tap                        -> nap 8, tong hop 8, bao xong 8/8 ✓
    mot tap khong nap duoc phu de         -> bo qua, chay tiep, xong 7/8 + 1 loi ✓
    loi TTS giua chung (het han muc...)   -> ghi nhan, KHONG dung hang doi, 7/8 ✓
    huy o tap 3                           -> dung han, xong 2/8, bo 6 tap ✓
    nap phu de THU CONG ngoai hang loat   -> KHONG tu chay TTS (giu hanh vi cu) ✓

### Hai thieu sot cua toi, do BO CANH GIU TINH bat duoc
1. Tao `self._btn_batch` nhung **quen `addWidget`** -> nut se khong bao gio hien.
2. Dung `QTimer.singleShot` nhung **quen import QTimer** -> NameError luc chay.
Ca hai bi bat boi `test_static_guards_v323323.py` (viet o v3.23.323 sau khi mac dung hai
loi nay). Da them ca viec khoa nut khi dang ban de khong xep chong hai hang doi.

## [3.23.328] — 🛑 Huy hang loat + 🔊 EdgeTTS chay duoc trong ban dong goi

### PHAN 1 — Trich xuat hang loat: nut Huy KHONG dung duoc hang doi

**Loi:** dang chay hang loat 40 tap, bam Huy -> chi dung TAP HIEN TAI roi hang doi
**tu chay tiep tap sau**. Nguoi dung khong thoat ra duoc, phai tat ca ung dung.
Nguyen nhan: `_on_extraction_finished` kiem `_batch_queue` TRUOC roi goi `_advance_batch()`
ngay, khong bao gio xet co `_is_cancelled_by_user`.

**Da sua:** them co `_batch_cancelled`. Bam Huy khi dang chay hang loat -> danh dau ca
hang doi, `_advance_batch` thay co thi ket thuc luon thay vi chay tap ke. Bao cao tong
ket phan biet ro "da huy" va neu SO TAP BI BO.

Da kiem chung 5 kich ban:
    chay het binh thuong      -> 10/10 tap ✓
    huy o tap 3               -> dung sau 3 tap, bo 8 tap, bao "da huy" ✓
    huy ngay tap dau          -> dung sau 1 tap ✓
    tap loi giua chung        -> VAN chay het 10 tap (hanh vi cu duoc giu) ✓
    trang thai duoc don sach  -> chay lai duoc ngay ✓

### PHAN 2 — EdgeTTS: hai loi khien no khong dung duoc

**🔴 Loi A: 4 goi bi BO SOT khoi requirements suot tu v3.23.312 — LOI CUA TOI**
v3.23.312 toi bao da them edge-tts/pedalboard/fastembed/scikit-learn. Nhung dieu kien
bao ve toi viet la:
    if "pedalboard" not in s:      # <-- SAI
Chu "pedalboard" DA CO SAN trong mot dong CHU THICH phia tren:
    librosa   # time-stretch giu cao do ISC (thay pedalboard GPL — 2 file)
=> Dieu kien luon False, khoi bi bo qua AM THAM, khong goi nao duoc them. Toi cung
khong kiem lai sau do. Log build cua ban xac nhan: khong co edge-tts trong danh sach cai.

Da them lai, va lan nay xac minh bang ham BO QUA DONG CHU THICH. Da viet test canh giu
dung cai bay nay (`test_comment_mentioning_package_does_not_count_as_declaration`).

**🔴 Loi B: ban dong goi BAT BUOC phai co Python ngoai moi chay duoc EdgeTTS**
Thiet ke cu (v3.23.268) CO Y khong dong goi edge-tts de cach ly GPL, nen adapter tim
Python he thong tren PATH; khong co thi bao that bai. Nhung spec DA gom `edge_tts` vao
bundle (dong 182) — mau thuan: thu vien nam san trong app ma van bao "khong chay duoc".
Va rang buoc GPL do khong con y nghia vi du an nay la ma nguon mo.

**Da sua:** them `_run_edge_in_process()` lam phuong an du phong:
    1. Co Python ngoai      -> subprocess (giu CACH LY: edge-tts treo khong sap app)
    2. Khong co / thieu worker -> chay THANG trong tien trinh
    3. Thieu ca thu vien    -> bao ro "pip install edge-tts", goi y VieNeu/Gemini
Tai dung CHINH ham `_mp3_to_wav` cua worker de hai duong cho ket qua y het nhau.
Giu gioi han 30s va don tep tam nhu ban subprocess.

**Xac minh API voi thu vien that** (da cai edge-tts 7.2.8):
    edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice, rate=...)  -> tham so khop ✓
    .save() la coroutine                          -> khop `await` cua adapter ✓
    tabulate 0.10.0 (phu thuoc bat buoc)          -> import duoc ✓
KHONG chay thu duoc tong hop that: mang container chan speech.platform.bing.com
(loi chung chi SSL). Day la gioi han moi truong, khong phai loi ma nguon.

### Hai loi TRONG TEST cua toi, tu bat va sua
1. `test_subprocess_is_still_preferred` so vi tri DINH NGHIA ham voi LOI GOI — hai thu
   nam khac cho trong tep nen ket luan sai. Sua: do trong THAN ham goi.
2. `test_in_process_has_timeout_and_cleanup` cat than ham theo do dai co dinh 2200 ky tu,
   trong khi than that dai 2356 -> hut mat phan cuoi. Sua: cat toi `def` ke tiep.
Ca hai deu bao "code sai" trong khi code dung — dung loai sai lam toi da mac o v3.23.325.

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG

## [3.23.327] — 📝 Kiem chung PHU DE MEM + thuyet minh, va sua loi MAT DINH DANG .ass

### Ban yeu cau kiem: phu de mem (khong phai hardsub) + thuyet minh co hoat dong khong?
**CO — nhung qua trinh kiem tim ra MOT LOI THAT can sua.**

### Cach kiem: TRICH NGUOC phu de ra khoi tep da xuat roi so tung cau
"Chay duoc" khong chung minh noi dung con nguyen. Nen toi trich lai phu de tu tep
.mkv da xuat va doi chieu voi ban goc.

**Ket qua chu:** nguyen ven 100% — ca dau tieng Viet ("Bát đệ, ngươi đã về rồi à?")
lan chu Han ("第19集").

**Ket qua thoi gian:** lech deu +21ms o MOI cau. Truy nguyen nhan:
    1024 mau / 48000 Hz = 21.3 ms   <-- do tre moi (priming delay) cua bo ma hoa AAC
Do start_time tung luong: video=0.000, audio=-0.021, subtitle=-0.021
=> **Tieng va phu de dich CUNG NHAU**, nen chung van khop nhau tuyet doi. Chi lech so
voi hinh, va 21ms < NUA KHUNG HINH o 25fps (40ms) — khong the nhan ra.
Da do truc tiep tren hinh: chu xuat hien giua moc 1.00s va 1.04s (goc 1.000s).
Da kiem KHONG tich luy: cau sau khong lech nhieu hon cau dau.
=> Khong can sua.

### 🔴 LOI THAT TIM DUOC: phu de .ass bi MAT SACH DINH DANG
`_subtitle_codec_for()` chon codec CHI theo dinh dang DICH:
    .mkv -> "srt"      .mp4 -> "mov_text"
Nghia la phu de `.ass` (co mau, kieu chu, vi tri) luon bi chuyen sang `srt`.
Do thuc te khi mux .ass bang codec srt:
    mau vang &H0000FFFF : MAT
    ten style 'Vang'    : MAT
    the vi tri {\an8}   : MAT
Dung codec `ass` thi giu duoc CA BA.

Anh huong that: ung dung CO xuat duoc .ass (ass_exporter.py), va phu de CJK thuong dung
dinh dang de phan biet nguoi noi / chu thich. Nguoi dung chon .ass roi xuat ban -> mat
het cong suc dinh dang ma khong duoc bao gi.

**Da sua:** chon codec theo CA nguon LAN dich:
| Nguon | Dich | Codec | Ghi chu |
|---|---|---|---|
| .srt | .mkv | srt | |
| .ass/.ssa | .mkv | **ass** | giu nguyen dinh dang |
| .srt | .mp4 | mov_text | |
| .ass | .mp4 | mov_text | MP4 KHONG chua duoc ASS -> bat buoc ha cap |

Rieng truong hop cuoi (ASS vao MP4) khong the giu duoc — nen them
`subtitle_styling_warning()` bao ro: "MP4 khong chua duoc dinh dang nay — se bi ha
thanh chu tron. Xuat ra .mkv de giu nguyen, hoac chon Phu de chay vao hinh."
Canh bao hien ngay tren dong trang thai trang Xuat ban.

### Kiem chung dau-cuoi (qua dung duong xuat ban cua app)
ASS co dinh dang + thuyet minh -> tep .mkv:
    codec phu de dung : ass ✓
    mau vang, style, the vi tri : giu nguyen ✓
    chu Viet co dau : nguyen ven ✓
    luong: video h264 + audio aac + subtitle ass(lang=vie) ✓

### Test
`test_soft_subtitle_v323327.py` — 13 test:
- Chon codec cho 5 cap (nguon, dich); canh bao chi hien khi that su mat dinh dang.
- **Chu song sot qua mux** (dau tieng Viet + chu Han).
- **Thoi gian lech duoi MOT khung hinh** va KHONG tich luy.
- **Dinh dang .ass song sot vao .mkv** (mau/style/vi tri).
- Track phu de duoc danh dau mac dinh + gan lang=vie.
- Phu de mem KHONG lam video phai ma hoa lai (uu diem chinh cua no).
Tong: **328 test PASS** (truoc 315).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG

## [3.23.326] — 🎬 Xuat ban: KET HOP duoc phu de + thuyet minh, va sua 2 loi ten tep

### 🔴 KHOANG TRONG LON NHAT: khong the co phu de VA thuyet minh cung luc
Ngay tu dau ban yeu cau "xuat ban phim co phu de va thuyet minh theo y nguoi dung".
Nhung 4 che do toi lam o v3.23.314/315 **LOAI TRU NHAU**:
| Che do cu | Phu de | Tieng Viet |
|---|---|---|
| SOFT_SUB | CO | khong |
| HARD_SUB | CO | khong (giu tieng goc) |
| VOICE_OVER | khong | CO |
| DUB_AUDIO | khong | CO |
=> Nguoi dung phai CHON MOT trong hai. Log thuc te cho thay hau qua: ban chon
`voice_over` nen phim ra KHONG co phu de, du phu de da duoc chuan bi san.

**Da sua:** tach thanh HAI CHIEU DOC LAP:
    SubtitleMode : NONE | SOFT (track) | BURNED (chay vao hinh)
    AudioMode    : ORIGINAL | VOICE_OVER (tron+ducking) | REPLACE_TRACK (track rieng)
=> 9 to hop, ke ca "phu de chay + thuyet minh" truoc day khong lam duoc.

**Diem ky thuat kho nhat:** ffmpeg KHONG cho dung dong thoi `-vf` va `-filter_complex`.
Khi vua chay phu de vua tron tieng, phai gop ca hai vao MOT filter_complex:
    [0:v]subtitles='...'[vout];[1:a]...asplit...[narr][key];[0:a]...[bg];
    [bg][key]sidechaincompress=...[ducked];[ducked][narr]amix=...[aout]
Va chi so input KHONG con co dinh `[1:a]` — no doi theo to hop, de cung se tron nham
luong. Da tham so hoa.

**Kiem chung bang ffmpeg that — ca 9 to hop:**
- 9/9 chay duoc, cau truc luong dung (so track hinh/tieng/phu de khop ky vong).
- To hop quan trong nhat (chay phu de + thuyet minh): do diem anh chu = 214 luc co phu
  de, 0 luc het -> phu de CHAY dung; do FFT: nen 200Hz = 0.00319, thuyet minh 1kHz =
  0.02206 -> co CA HAI.
- Ducking van hoat dong khi ket hop: nen khi chi tron tieng = 0.00319, khi kem chay phu
  de = 0.00319 (chenh <1%) -> chay phu de KHONG pha phan tron tieng.
- Vi tri chu: y=165..173/180 (o day), can giua ✓

### 🔴 LOI TEN TEP 1: doi che do ma ten khong doi
Log that: `Xuất video (voice_over): 第19集.mp4 -> 第19集_phude.mkv`
Che do la thuyet minh nhung ten tep mang hau to cua kieu PHU DE ROI. Nguyen nhan:
`_suggest_output_path()` chi dien khi o TRONG, nen doi che do sau do khong cap nhat.

### 🔴 LOI TEN TEP 2: doi VIDEO GOC ma ten dich khong doi (ban yeu cau kiem)
Nghiem trong hon loi 1: chon video A -> ten `A_phude.mkv`; doi sang video B -> VAN giu
`A_phude.mkv`. Tuc xuat phim B vao tep mang ten A, va neu bam xuat lan nua se **GHI DE
ket qua cua phim A**. Voi quy trinh phim bo nhieu tap, loi nay de mat du lieu.

**Da sua ca hai:** ten tep tu cap nhat theo CA video nguon LAN cap che do, nhung KHONG
bao gio ghi de ten do nguoi dung tu go. Nhan biet bang cach so ten hien tai voi moi goi
y kha di cua **video ma goi y do thuoc ve** (theo doi qua `_output_source`) — chi tiet
quan trong: phai so voi video CU, khong phai video moi.

Da kiem chung 4 kich ban + tinh duy nhat:
    doi che do        -> 第19集_phude.mkv -> 第19集_thuyetminh.mkv ✓
    doi video         -> 第19集_phude_thuyetminh.mkv -> 第21集_phude_thuyetminh.mkv ✓
    ten tu go         -> giu nguyen qua ca doi che do lan doi video ✓
    9 to hop          -> 9 ten KHAC NHAU, khong to hop nao ghi de to hop khac ✓

### Giao dien
Thay MOT o "Kieu xuat" bang HAI o doc lap: "Phu de" va "Am thanh". Goi y dong duoi tu
mo ta he qua cua cap dang chon (toc do, chat luong). Chan neu khong chon gi de them.

### Tuong thich nguoc
`RenderMode` cu duoc giu; `resolve_modes()` tu suy cap tuong ung neu ma cu chi dat
`mode`. 32 test cua v3.23.314 van PASS khong sua logic (chi doi mot khang dinh tu
`-c copy` gop sang `-c:v copy` + `-c:a copy` tach — da xac minh hanh vi tuong duong).

### Test
- `test_render_modes_v323326.py` (20 test): anh xa che do cu, ket hop 2 chieu, gop
  filter_complex, chi copy video khi khong chay, chi so input dung, thu tu track,
  kiem dau vao, va **9 to hop chay that voi ffmpeg**.
- `test_output_naming_v323326.py` (11 test): doi che do, doi video, to hop, ten tu go
  duoc giu, 5 tap lien tiep khong trung ten, 9 to hop 9 ten.
Tong: **315 test PASS** (truoc 284).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Ban can thu:
1. Chon "Phu de roi" + "Thuyet minh" -> xuat -> phim phai co CA phu de bat/tat duoc
   LAN giong Viet tron voi nhac nen.
2. Doi qua lai giua cac lua chon -> ten tep dich phai doi theo moi lan.
3. Doi video gốc sang tap khac -> ten tep dich phai doi theo tap moi.
4. Tu go ten rieng roi doi che do/video -> ten phai duoc GIU NGUYEN.

## [3.23.325] — 🛡️ Trang Trich xuat: kiem TRUOC khi chay + bao dung khi ra 0 cau

### Phan tich tiep — hai lo hong ve XU LY LOI

**1. ❌ KHONG kiem gi truoc khi chay**
`start_extraction()` chi xet dung 2 dieu kien:
    if self._video is None or self._is_busy: return
Nghia la KHONG kiem: ROI co nam trong khung hinh khong, ROI co qua nho khong, tep video
con ton tai khong. Nguoi dung cho xong (co the hang chuc phut) moi biet hong.
Truong hop hay gap nhat: doi sang video KHAC DO PHAN GIAI ma quen ve lai ROI -> ROI cu
nam ngoai khung -> OCR ra rac hoac loi.

**2. 🔴 Ra 0 cau van bao THANH CONG (mau xanh)**
    self._status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {_c.success()};")
    self._status_label.setText(f"✓ Hoàn tất! {len(response.events)} câu ... → Đã lưu vào Database")
Neu `len(events) == 0` thi hien thi:
    "✓ Hoàn tất! 0 câu trong 412.3s → Đã lưu vào Database"   (MAU XANH)
Vua SAI (khong luu gi vao database) vua khien nguoi dung tuong phim khong co phu de,
trong khi nguyen nhan thuong la ROI chua trung cho hoac sai ngon ngu OCR.

### DA HOAN THIEN

**`application/services/extraction_preflight.py` (MOI, thuan, testable)**

*Kiem truoc khi chay* — phan biet CHAN (chac chan hong) vs CANH BAO (van chay duoc):
| Tinh huong | Xu ly |
|---|---|
| Chua chon video / tep khong ton tai | ⛔ CHAN |
| Khong doc duoc kich thuoc khung hinh | ⛔ CHAN |
| ROI nam ngoai khung hinh | ⛔ CHAN |
| ROI kich thuoc 0 | ⛔ CHAN |
| ROI rat nho (<24x12 px, nghi keo truot tay) | ⚠️ canh bao, hoi tiep tuc |
| ROI phu >60% chieu cao khung | ⚠️ canh bao (cham + de bat nham chu trong canh phim) |
| Khong doc duoc thoi luong | ⚠️ canh bao (chi mat % tien do) |
Moi van de deu KEM HUONG XU LY, khong chi bao loi.

*Chan doan khi ra 0 cau* — xep nguyen nhan theo KHA NANG, dua tren du lieu that:
- `frames_processed == 0` -> loi TEP (codec la / o mang), KHONG do loi nham cho ROI.
- Co ROI    -> "Vung OCR chua trung vi tri phu de — nguyen nhan hay gap nhat…"
- Khong ROI -> "Tu do ROI khong tim duoc dai phu de — hay tu ve vung…"
- Luon nhac: sai ngon ngu OCR (NEU RO ma dang dung), va goi y "Quet track phu de nhung"
  neu phim khong co phu de chay.
- Rieng che do Thu nhanh: them "doan thu roi vao cho khong co thoai — thu doan khac".

**Noi vao trang:**
- Chan truoc khi chay o CA nut Bat dau lan Thu nhanh.
- Ra 0 cau -> dong trang thai mau CANH BAO + hop thoai giai thich, va **thoat som**
  nen khong con roi vao nhanh bao thanh cong.

### Mot sai sot cua toi trong luc kiem
Buoc xac minh dau tien cua toi bao "✗ van con bao xanh nham" — nhung do la LOI CUA
PHEP KIEM: no tim chuoi "✓ Hoàn tất!" ma khong bo qua dong CHU THICH (toi vua viet chu
thich co chua chinh chuoi do). Kiem lai bang cach loc dong chu thich -> luong dung:
    def _on_extraction_finished  : dong 1420
    if not response.events:      : dong 1448   <- truoc
    "✓ Hoàn tất!" (ma thuc thi)  : dong 1455   <- sau, va co return som o giua

### Test
`test_extraction_preflight_v323325.py` — 18 test: 2 truong hop chay duoc, 5 truong hop
phai chan, 3 truong hop chi canh bao, 2 test trinh bay (phai kem huong xu ly),
6 test chan doan (0 khung -> loi tep khong do loi ROI; liet ke nguyen nhan; tu-do-ROI
co loi khuyen khac; che do thu goi y doan khac; neu ro ten ngon ngu).
Tong: **284 test PASS** (truoc 266).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
1. Mo video A, ve ROI, roi mo video B KHAC DO PHAN GIAI -> bam Bat dau: phai bi CHAN
   voi thong bao "Vung OCR nam ngoai khung hinh".
2. Ve ROI vao vung khong co chu roi chay -> phai hien hop thoai giai thich 3-4 nguyen
   nhan, dong trang thai mau vang (KHONG con mau xanh "Hoan tat! 0 cau").
3. Chay binh thuong co phu de -> phai khong bi hoi gi them (khong canh bao thua).

## [3.23.324] — 🔬 SUA TAN GOC 4 ngon ngu OCR hong — bang cach TRA MA NGUON, khong doan

Ban truoc toi ghi "can dieu tra them, toi khong doan tiep". Ban nay da dieu tra xong.

### Cach lam: doc thang ma nguon paddleocr 3.7
Tai `paddleocr-3.7.0` + `paddlex-3.7.2` tu PyPI roi doc:
    paddleocr/_utils/langs.py       — dinh nghia cac tap ngon ngu
    paddleocr/_pipelines/ocr.py     — logic phan giai lang -> ten model

### 🔴 NGUYEN NHAN THAT (khac hoan toan gia thuyet cu cua toi)
`latin` / `cyrillic` / `arabic` / `devanagari` **KHONG PHAI ma ngon ngu** — chung la
**TEN NHOM HE CHU VIET**. Logic thuc te trong ocr.py:

    elif lang in LATIN_LANGS:      rec_lang = "latin"      # -> latin_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec
    elif lang in ARABIC_LANGS:     rec_lang = "arabic"
    elif lang in CYRILLIC_LANGS:   rec_lang = "cyrillic"
    elif lang in DEVANAGARI_LANGS: rec_lang = "devanagari"

Nguoi dung truyen ma THANH VIEN (vd `fr`), PaddleOCR moi TU SUY ra model nhom.
Do bang chinh du lieu cua thu vien:

    'latin'      nam trong LATIN_LANGS?      False
    'cyrillic'   nam trong CYRILLIC_LANGS?   False
    'arabic'     nam trong ARABIC_LANGS?     False
    'devanagari' nam trong DEVANAGARI_LANGS? False

=> Truyen ten nhom vao LUON that bai, khong `ocr_version` nao cuu duoc.

### ⚠️ TU KIEM DIEM: gia thuyet v3.23.303 cua toi SAI
Luc do toi ket luan "4 nhom nay chi co model duoi PP-OCRv5" roi them bang ep
`ocr_version="PP-OCRv5"`. Log build ban gui da bac bo:
    No models are available for lang='latin' and ocr_version='PP-OCRv5'
Toi da suy dien tu THONG DIEP LOI (`ocr_version=None`) thay vi doc ma nguon. Bai hoc:
thong diep loi goi y trieu chung, khong phai nguyen nhan.

Te hon: **test cua toi luc do PASS** vi no chi kiem "bang anh xa co khop gia dinh
khong" — mot test chi khang dinh chinh gia dinh cua minh thi khong bao gio bat duoc
gia dinh sai.

### DA SUA TAN GOC
**1. Thay 4 ma nhom sai bang 8 ma THANH VIEN that** trong UI_LANGUAGE_CHOICES:
    Truoc (hong):  latin, cyrillic, arabic, devanagari
    Nay (chay duoc): fr, de, es, pt, id (chu Latin) | ru (Kirin) | ar | hi (Devanagari)
Da doi chieu TUNG MA voi tap ngon ngu that cua paddleocr: 8/8 hop le ✓
Anh huong: 4 muc nay truoc day KHONG chi hong luc prefetch ma con hong CA LUC CHAY
neu nguoi dung chon — nay dung duoc.

**2. Go bang ep ocr_version** (gia thuyet sai). Giu module + API de khong pha noi goi,
nhung bang nay TRONG va docstring ghi ro lich su de khong ai lap lai.

**3. Viet lai test cu thay vi xoa** — test v323303 truoc day khang dinh dieu SAI. Nay
kiem DUNG thu quan trong:
    - Ten nhom KHONG duoc xuat hien lam ma ngon ngu (canh giu loi nay).
    - Moi he chu viet lon phai tiep can duoc qua it nhat mot ma thanh vien.
    - Ngon ngu cot loi (CJK + vi + en) luon co mat.
    - Bang ep phien ban phai trong.

### Ket qua ky vong o lan build sau
Buoc prefetch se tai duoc model cho ca 8 ngon ngu moi (thay vi 4 canh bao that bai),
va nguoi dung chon Phap/Nga/A-Rap/Hindi trong trang Trich xuat se OCR duoc that.

## [3.23.322] — ♻️ Trang Trich xuat: cache OCR + DUNG LAI phu de tuc thi

### Phan tich tiep — hai lo hong lien quan nhau

**1. Ket qua OCR bi VUT BO sau moi lan chay**
`extract_subtitles.py` chi luu OCR tho khi `request.raw_ocr_output_path is not None` —
ma tham so nay CHI duoc dat khi nguoi dung bam nut go loi "Xuat du lieu tho OCR".
Chay binh thuong -> OCR xong, dung phu de, roi **vut toan bo ket qua OCR**.

**2. `ProjectRecord.ocr_raw_json` la truong CHET**
Truong ton tai trong ban ghi du an nhung grep toan bo `main_window`: **khong cho nao ghi**.
(Giong het loi `WorkflowStage.EDITED` da sua o v3.23.316.)

**Hau qua thuc te — vong lap tinh chinh cuc cham:**
OCR mot tap 40 phut mat hang chuc phut; dung cau phu de chi mat VAI GIAY. Nhung muon
doi mot tham so dung cau (nguong gop, do tuong dong, thoi luong toi thieu…) de cai
thien chat luong thi phai **chay lai TOAN BO OCR**. Doi 3 tham so = doi 3 lan x hang
chuc phut.

Dang chu y: du an DA CO san `tools/replay_subtitle_builder.py` lam dung viec nay
(nap OCR tho -> dung lai -> do F1/CER), va `load_raw_ocr()` da co trong serializer.
Ha tang day du — chi thieu phan noi vao ung dung.

### DA HOAN THIEN

**1. Tu luu cache OCR sau moi lan trich xuat**
`<ten>.seraw.json.gz` canh video (nen gzip vi du lieu OCR mot tap rat lon; serializer
tu nen khi thay duoi `.gz`). Theo dung tien le da co: STT tu luu `.sestt.json`.

**2. Nut "🔁 Dung lai tu OCR da luu"**
Nap cache -> dung phu de bang **tham so DANG DAT tren giao dien** -> hien ket qua.
Khong chay lai OCR. Vong lap tinh chinh tu hang chuc phut xuong vai giay.
Nut chi BAT khi video hien tai that su co cache (tu cap nhat moi lan nap video).

### Quy uoc dat ten — da kiem khong dung do
Cache `<ten>.seraw.json.gz` KHONG duoc trung cac tep khac cua quy trinh:
    .original.srt   (trich xuat)
    .translate.srt  (dich)
    .tts.<lang>.srt (TTS)
Da co test doi chieu truc tiep — trung la ghi de mat du lieu.

### Test
`test_raw_ocr_cache_path_v323322.py` — 10 test: quy uoc ten (3 dang duong dan), bat
buoc `.gz`, nam canh video, on dinh khi goi nhieu lan, **khong dung do voi tep khac**,
cung ten goc khac duoi video thi dung chung cache.
Tong: **241 test PASS** (truoc 231, khong hoi quy).

### ⚠️ Danh doi can biet
Cache OCR chiem them dung luong dia canh moi video (da nen gzip nen nho hon nhieu so
voi ban .json thuong). Neu ban muon tat, hien tai phai xoa tep thu cong — toi chua lam
tuy chon tat vi chua ro ban co muon khong.

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Ban can thu:
1. Chay trich xuat 1 tap -> kiem canh video co tep `<ten>.seraw.json.gz` khong.
2. Doi mot tham so dung cau (vd nguong gop cau) -> bam "🔁 Dung lai tu OCR da luu"
   -> phai ra ket qua trong vai giay va SO CAU phai khac lan truoc.
3. Mo mot video CHUA tung trich xuat -> nut phai TAT (mo).
4. Kiem cache co lam ban chay lai binh thuong khong (bam Bat dau van phai chay OCR that).

### Con lai co the lam
- Tuy chon tat/bat tu luu cache + nut don cache cu (neu ban thay ton dia).
- Hien so cau truoc/sau khi dung lai de so sanh nhanh khi tinh chinh.

## [3.23.321] — 🈳 Trang Trich xuat: chon ngon ngu OCR + chon doan thu ngay tai trang

Hoan thanh 2 viec con lai da neu o cuoi v3.23.320.

### 1. Chon NGON NGU OCR ngay tren trang Trich xuat
**Van de:** trang co o "Ngon ngu OCR anh" nhung CHI danh cho track anh nhung
(VobSub/PGS). Ngon ngu cho OCR phu de chay (`OcrSettings.language`, mac dinh "ch") chi
doi duoc trong trang **Cai dat**. Voi phim bo CJK phai doi Trung/Nhat/Han theo tung bo
-> moi lan phai roi trang Trich xuat sang trang khac roi quay lai.

**Da sua:** them o "Ngon ngu phu de" ngay canh nut Bat dau, nap tu `UI_LANGUAGE_CHOICES`
(11 ngon ngu app ho tro) + muc dau "Theo Cai dat".

Co che uu tien (kiem chung 4 truong hop):
    chon rong / chi khoang trang  -> dung gia tri trong Cai dat ("ch")
    chon "japan" / "korean" ...   -> dung gia tri vua chon
Chi ap dung cho PHIEN LAM VIEC nay, khong ghi de Cai dat mac dinh — doi thu nhanh ma
khong lam anh huong cac lan sau.

Ky thuat: `set_ocr_language_override()` tren view model; `_build_requests()` goi
`_effective_ocr_language(snapshot)` thay vi doc thang `snapshot.ocr.language`.

### 2. Chon DOAN THU cho "Thu nhanh"
Truoc: luon thu giua phim. Neu doan giua khong co thoai (canh chuyen canh, canh hanh
dong khong loi) thi ket qua rong, nguoi dung tuong OCR hong.
**Da sua:** o chon 5 vi tri — Dau / 1/4 / Giua (mac dinh) / 3/4 / Cuoi phim.

Do thuc te tren phim 45 phut, ca 5 vi tri deu hop le:
    Dau phim   -> tu 01:45 den 02:45
    1/4 phim   -> tu 10:45 den 11:45
    Giua phim  -> tu 22:00 den 23:00
    3/4 phim   -> tu 33:15 den 34:15
    Cuoi phim  -> tu 42:15 den 43:15
Tat ca: do dai dung 60s, khong tran khung, `skip_intro + skip_outro < duration`.
Logic da co san tu v3.23.320 (`center_ratio`), ban nay chi noi phan giao dien.

### Tong ket trang Trich xuat sau 3 ban (v319 → v321)
| Khoang trong tim duoc | Trang thai |
|---|---|
| Khong xu ly hang loat nhieu tap | ✅ v3.23.319 |
| ROI toa do tuyet doi -> sai khi khac do phan giai | ✅ v3.23.319 (tu co gian + danh dau) |
| Khong co cach thu nhanh truoc khi chay ca tap | ✅ v3.23.320 |
| Ngon ngu OCR chinh khong co tren trang | ✅ v3.23.321 |
| Khong chon duoc doan thu | ✅ v3.23.321 |

### Test
231 test PASS (khong hoi quy). Cac phan logic moi da do truc tiep:
- Uu tien ngon ngu: 4/4 truong hop dung (rong, khoang trang, japan, korean).
- 5 vi tri thu: deu hop le tren phim 45 phut.

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Ban can thu:
1. Doi "Ngon ngu phu de" sang Nhat -> chay thu nhanh tren phim Nhat, phai doc dung chu.
2. Doi ve "Theo Cai dat" -> phai quay lai dung ngon ngu trong trang Cai dat.
3. Doi ngon ngu KHONG duoc lam thay doi Cai dat mac dinh (mo trang Cai dat kiem lai).
4. Thu nhanh o "Dau phim" va "Cuoi phim" -> ket qua phai khac nhau, va khop voi noi dung
   thuc te o doan do.

## [3.23.320] — ⚡ Trang Trich xuat: THU NHANH truoc khi chay ca tap

### Phan tich tiep — hai khoang trong con lai

**1. ❌ KHONG co cach thu nhanh (nghiem trong nhat)**
Trich xuat mot tap 40 phut mat rat nhieu thoi gian. Neu ROI ve sai, chon nham ngon ngu,
hay tham so chua hop -> nguoi dung chi phat hien **SAU KHI da chay xong**, mat toi hang
chuc phut roi phai lam lai tu dau. Grep toan trang: khong co preview/dry-run/test nao.

**2. ⚠️ Ngon ngu OCR chinh khong co tren trang Trich xuat**
Trang co o "Ngon ngu OCR anh" nhung CHI danh cho track anh nhung (VobSub/PGS).
Ngon ngu cho OCR phu de chay (`OcrSettings.language`, mac dinh "ch") chi doi duoc trong
trang Cai dat. Voi phim bo CJK phai doi qua lai Trung/Nhat/Han theo tung bo -> moi lan
phai sang trang khac. (Chua sua o ban nay — xem muc "Con lai".)

### DA HOAN THIEN: nut "⚡ Thu nhanh 60 giay"

Dat canh nut Bat dau. Chay OCR thu tren MOT DOAN NGAN GIUA PHIM voi dung ROI + tham so
dang dat, cho ket qua sau ~10 giay:
    Thu nhanh 60 giay (tu 22:00 den 23:00)
    Nhan duoc 12 cau. Vai cau dau:
    • 你好世界
    • 我们走吧
    Neu chu doc dung, hay chay trich xuat day du.

**Khong ra cau nao -> NEU RO can kiem gi** (thay vi chi bao "that bai"):
    • Vung ROI chua trung vi tri phu de — ve lai hoac bam "Tu do ROI".
    • Sai ngon ngu OCR — kiem trong Cai dat.
    • Doan thu roi vao cho khong co thoai — thu doan khac.
    • Phim khong co phu de chay — dung "Quet track phu de nhung".

### Cach lam: tai dung 100% duong chay hien co
Khong them duong dan code moi trong pipeline. Chi bo pham vi lay mau bang
`FrameSamplingConfig.skip_intro_sec` / `skip_outro_sec` (da co san) + `skip_export=True`.
=> Ket qua thu **phan anh trung thuc** ket qua chay that tren doan do.

**Thu doan nao?** Mac dinh GIUA phim. Dau phim thuong la intro/logo khong co thoai,
cuoi la credits — thu o do de ra rong khien nguoi dung tuong OCR hong.

### Bat bien quan trong da kiem
`skip_intro_sec + skip_outro_sec < duration` — vi pham la bo lay mau khong con khung
hinh nao, lan thu ra rong va nguoi dung tuong OCR hong. Da kiem tren 6 do dai video.
Video ngan hon cua so -> thu TOAN BO, khong cat (cat chi to mat du lieu).

### Kien truc
`application/services/ocr_probe_window.py` (THUAN, khong Qt):
- `compute_probe_window()` — tinh cua so + gia tri skip, kep vao khoang hop le.
- `summarise_probe_result()` — sinh thong diep, phan biet ro truong hop rong.
View model them `start_probe_extraction()`; trang dung co `_is_probing` de khi xong thi
HIEN HOP THOAI thay vi nap sang Bien tap/luu du an.

### Test
`test_ocr_probe_window_v323320.py` — 29 test:
- Bat bien skip khong nuot het video (6 do dai), cua so nam trong video, dat giua phim,
  do dai dung yeu cau, 5 vi tri tam khac nhau deu khong tran, video ngan -> thu toan bo,
  thoi luong am, cua so lon hon video.
- Thong diep: rong thi neu du 4 nguyen nhan + goi y duong vao khac; co ket qua thi hien
  cau mau; danh sach dai thi cat bot.
Tong: **231 test PASS** (truoc 202, khong hoi quy).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Logic da do that (29 test).
Ban can thu:
1. Mo 1 tap, ve ROI, bam "⚡ Thu nhanh 60 giay" -> phai co ket qua sau ~10 giay.
2. Co tinh ve ROI SAI cho -> phai bao "KHONG nhan duoc cau nao" kem 4 goi y.
3. Sau khi thu, bam Bat dau -> chay day du binh thuong (co thu khong lam hong lan chay that).
4. Thu nhanh xong KHONG duoc chuyen sang tab Bien tap va KHONG ghi tep .srt nao.

### Con lai co the lam (de ban chon)
- **Dua o chon ngon ngu OCR chinh ra trang Trich xuat** — de doi Trung/Nhat/Han theo bo
  ma khong phai sang trang Cai dat. (Khoang trong #2 o tren.)
- Cho chon vi tri thu (dau/giua/cuoi) va do dai cua so tren giao dien — logic da ho tro
  san (`center_ratio`, `probe_seconds`), chi thieu phan giao dien.

## [3.23.319] — 🎞️ Trang Trich xuat: them TRICH XUAT HANG LOAT nhieu tap

### PHAN TICH TRANG TRICH XUAT

**Chuc nang hien co — DA DAY DU ✅** (4 duong vao, bao phu tot):
| Cach | Dung khi |
|---|---|
| OCR phu de chay | phim khong co track phu de (chinh) |
| Quet track phu de nhung | phim co san track (nhanh, chinh xac) |
| Nap phu de roi | da co .srt/.ass ben ngoai |
| Phien am giong noi (STT) | khong co phu de nao |
Kem: mo lai ban OCR da luu trong CSDL, xuat du lieu tho .seraw.json de go loi,
tu do ROI, tu do phu de chay, kiem duyet lai ROI.

**LO HONG LON NHAT ❌ — khong xu ly HANG LOAT**
`QFileDialog.getOpenFileName` (SO IT) -> moi lan chi mo duoc MOT video.
Ung dung phuc vu **phim bo CJK** — moi bo hang chuc tap, vi tri phu de gan nhu giong
het nhau. Nguoi dung phai lap lai TOAN BO thao tac (chon tep -> ve ROI -> dat tham so
-> chay -> cho) cho tung tap. Voi bo 40 tap la 40 lan.
(Luu y: `sibling_video_finder.py` co san nhung chi de tim video canh tep phu de o trang
Dich — khong lien quan xu ly nhieu tap.)

### DA HOAN THIEN: trich xuat hang loat

**Nut moi "🎞️ Trich xuat hang loat…"** canh nut chon video:
1. Chon nhieu tap cung luc (`getOpenFileNames`).
2. Hien BANG KE HOACH de xac nhan truoc khi chay:
       "12 tap se chay · 2 da co gian ROI · 3 bo qua (da co) · 1 loi"
3. Chay tuan tu, dung CHUNG ROI + tham so dang dat.
4. Tap loi KHONG lam dung ca hang doi — ghi nhan roi chay tiep.
5. Xong bao tong ket, liet ke tap that bai.

### 🔴 CAI BAY DA XU LY: ROI la toa do TUYET DOI
`Roi` luu x/y/width/height bang DIEM ANH. Neu cac tap khac do phan giai (rat hay gap
khi tron nguon tai ve), dung lai ROI nguyen xi se **cat sai vung** — OCR ra rac ma
KHONG bao loi gi.
**Da xu ly:** `scale_roi()` tu co gian ROI theo ti le, kep trong khung hinh dich, va
DANH DAU muc do (`ROI_SCALED`) kem ghi chu "nen kiem lai" de nguoi dung biet.
Do duoc:
    720x1280 -> 1080x1920 : x100 y1000 520x200 -> x150 y1500 780x300  (nam trong khung ✓)
    720x1280 -> 360x640   : -> x50  y500  260x100                     (✓)
    720x1280 -> 1280x720  : -> x178 y562  924x112  (doi ca huong khung ✓)
    Gap doi chinh xac     : x100->200, y1000->2000, 520x200 -> 1040x400

### Kien truc
`application/services/batch_extraction_plan.py` (THUAN, khong Qt) — lap ke hoach:
- `scale_roi()` — co gian + kep bien, giu nguyen can le/huong chu.
- `build_batch_plan()` — tra ve danh sach `BatchItem` voi trang thai:
  READY / ROI_SCALED / SKIPPED_EXISTS / INVALID.
- `summarise_plan()` — tom tat mot dong de hien thi.
Nho tach thuan nen kiem thu duoc day du khong can man hinh.

Tang giao dien chi lo dieu phoi: nap tap -> ap ROI da co gian -> chay -> tin hieu
xong/loi -> `QTimer.singleShot(0, ...)` sang tap ke (tra quyen ve vong lap su kien,
tranh de quy sau va de giao dien kip ve lai).

### Hai thieu sot cua toi da tu bat va sua
1. Tao nut nhung **QUEN them vao layout** -> nut se khong bao gio hien. Da them
   `select_row.addWidget(self._batch_button)`.
2. Dung `logger` trong khi tep **chua khai bao logger** -> NameError luc chay. Da them
   `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`.
Ca hai deu bat duoc bang xac minh tinh, khong phai doan.

### Test
`test_batch_extraction_plan_v323319.py` — 18 test:
- Co gian ROI: cung co, gap doi chinh xac, 5 do phan giai khac nhau deu NAM TRON trong
  khung dich, giu nguyen can le/huong chu, tham so khong hop le -> None.
- Ke hoach: giu dung thu tu, ten tep ra `.original.srt` (khong ghi de ban dich/TTS),
  bo qua tap da co, ep chay lai duoc, danh dau tap can co gian ROI, tep thieu -> INVALID,
  khong co ROI mau -> tu do tung tap, tom tat dem du 4 loai.
Tong: **202 test PASS** (truoc 184, khong hoi quy).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Logic da do that (18 test + do
thuc nghiem co gian ROI). Ban can thu:
1. Mo 1 tap, ve ROI, bam "Trich xuat hang loat…", chon 3-4 tap.
2. Kiem bang ke hoach hien dung so tap se chay / bo qua.
3. Chay -> phai tu chuyen tap, khong hien hop thoai giua chung.
4. Thu tron mot tap khac do phan giai -> phai bao "da co gian ROI", va kiem ket qua
   OCR tap do co dung vung khong.
5. Thu mot tep hong -> phai chay tiep cac tap con lai, cuoi cung liet ke tap loi.

## [3.23.318] — 🔴 SUA LOI LECH DONG BO: Xuat ban dung SAI tep phu de

### Cau hoi cua nguoi dung da phat hien MOT LOI THAT
"O khau TTS ung dung co xuat phu de dong bo voi am thanh TTS, vay khi xuat ban co su
dung phu de nay chua?" — **CHUA. Va do la loi.**

### Bang chung
1. `generate_tts.py` co ham `_export_adjusted_srt()` — khau TTS khong chi tao giong doc
   ma con **CHINH LAI MOC THOI GIAN** phu de cho khop loi thoai da tong hop (nen/gian
   cau, doi cau khi thieu cho), roi ghi ra tep RIENG:
       <ten>.tts.<lang>.srt      (vd: phim.tts.vi.srt)
   Chinh giao dien trang TTS cung ghi ro: "Xuat kem file .srt moi khop loi thoai da doi",
   "Khi Elastic timing doi dong, .srt tu khop lai".
2. Nhung `main_window._export_translated_subtitle_temp()` lai lay:
       events = self._collect_translated_events() or self._collect_editor_events()
   -> tuc phu de tu **trang Dich**, MOC THOI GIAN GOC, chua chinh.

**Hau qua:** xuat phim kem CA phu de LAN thuyet minh thi phu de LECH so voi giong noi.
Cang ve sau cang lech (drift tich luy do TTS doi dan cac cau).

### Da sua
**`application/services/publish_subtitle_selector.py` (moi, thuan, test duoc)**
Thu tu uu tien:
    1. Phu de DONG BO TTS  (<ten>.tts.<lang>.srt -> roi <ten>.tts.srt)
    2. Ban dich (moc goc)  — khi chua chay TTS
    3. Khong co gi
Tra ve ca `source` va `warning` de tang tren biet ma bao nguoi dung.

**Canh bao khi co nguy co lech:** neu da chay TTS (co tep am thanh) NHUNG khong tim
thay phu de dong bo, va ban xuat CO kem giong doc -> tra ve canh bao ro rang thay vi
im lang dung ban co the sai.

**Minh bach tren giao dien:** trang Xuat ban hien ghi chu ngay duoi dong trang thai:
    ✓ Phu de da khop giong doc.                      (khi dung ban .tts.*.srt)
    ⚠ Phu de dang dung moc thoi gian GOC, co the lech so voi giong doc.
      Chay lai khau TTS de tao phu de dong bo.        (khi co giong nhung dung ban dich)

### Chi tiet ky thuat
- Tim ca 2 bien the ten tep: co ma ngon ngu truoc, roi khong co — vi `tts_subtitle_path`
  chi chen ma ngon ngu KHI biet ngon ngu luc tong hop.
- Ma ngon ngu dang "vi-VN" tu rut gon ve "vi" (da co san trong `output_naming`).
- Lay ngon ngu dich tu `ProjectRecord.target_lang` cua du an hien hanh.
- Tach `_write_translated_subtitle_temp()` rieng (chi lo ghi tep tam) khoi
  `_export_translated_subtitle_temp()` (lo CHON nguon) — dung SRP.

### Test
`test_publish_subtitle_selector_v323318.py` — 10 test:
- Tim bien the co/khong ma ngon ngu; khong co tep; chua chay TTS.
- **Uu tien ban dong bo hon ban dich** (chinh la loi duoc sua).
- Canh bao khi co giong doc ma thieu ban dong bo.
- KHONG canh bao thua khi xuat chi co phu de (khong kem giong) — luc do moc goc la dung.
- Quy uoc ten khop dung thu `generate_tts` ghi ra: phim.tts.vi.srt / phim.tts.srt.
Tong: **184 test PASS** (truoc 174, khong hoi quy).

### ⚠️ CAN BAN KIEM CHUNG
Khong co PySide6/man hinh nen chua chay thu giao dien. Logic da do that (5/5 kich ban).
Ban can thu:
1. Chay het quy trinh toi TTS -> kiem trong thu muc co tep `*.tts.vi.srt` khong.
2. Vao trang Xuat ban -> o phu de phai TU DIEN tep `.tts.vi.srt` do (khong phai ban dich),
   va dong trang thai phai hien "✓ Phu de da khop giong doc".
3. Xuat kieu "Thuyet minh" + phu de -> phat thu, phu de phai khop giong noi.
4. Neu co tinh xoa tep .tts.srt roi vao lai -> phai hien canh bao ⚠.

## [3.23.317] — 🧭 Thanh tien do quy trinh + nhay toi buoc tiep + xem phim da xuat

Hoan thanh 3 viec da len ke hoach o cuoi v3.23.316.

### 1. Thanh tien do quy trinh (moi) — luon hien tren dau vung noi dung
`presentation/widgets/workflow_bar.py`
    ● Trich xuat  →  ● Bien tap  →  ○ Dich  →  ○ TTS  →  ○ Xuat ban
                              Tiep theo: Dich phu de sang tieng Viet   [Di toi]
- Cham DAY = khau da xong, cham RONG = chua toi.
- Khau cuoi thi an nut va bao "Da hoan thanh toan bo quy trinh".
- Tu lam moi sau moi khau hoan thanh VA moi lan doi trang (7 diem goi).

**Cach gan an toan:** boc `stackedWidget` vao mot widget doc [thanh, noi dung] roi dat
lai dung vi tri cu trong layout. Cach nay KHONG phu thuoc cau truc cu the cua lop cua
so nen chay duoc voi CA `fluent_compat` lan `qfluentwidgets`. Neu bo cuc khac du kien
(qfluentwidgets doi cau truc) -> bo qua trong im lang, ung dung van chay binh thuong,
chi la khong co thanh.

### 2. Nut "Di toi" — nhay thang toi trang cua buoc tiep theo
`_switch_to_page_key(object_name)` tim trang theo `objectName` roi `switchTo`.
Dung `next_page_key` da them o v3.23.316.

### 3. Thu vien: nut "Xem phim da xuat"
- Mo tep phim hoan chinh bang ung dung mac dinh cua he dieu hanh (QDesktopServices).
- Nut CHI BAT khi du an that su co tep da xuat VA tep con ton tai tren dia — tranh
  truong hop bam roi khong co gi xay ra vi tep da bi di chuyen/xoa.
- Tep khong con -> bao ro "chua xuat ban, hoac tep da bi di chuyen/xoa".

### 4. 🔍 CANH GIU MOT RANG BUOC DE HONG AM THAM
Nut "Di toi" chuyen trang bang cach so `objectName`. Neu ai do doi ten doi tuong cua
mot trang ma quen sua `next_page_key`, nut se **hong am tham**: khong loi, khong log,
bam khong co gi xay ra.
Da doi chieu that — ca 5 khop chinh xac:
    extractPage / editorPage / translatePage / ttsPage / publishPage
Va viet `test_workflow_navigation_v323317.py` (8 test) DOC THANG MA NGUON cac trang de
bat loi nay ve sau. Test khong can Qt/man hinh.

**Mot loi cua toi trong luc viet test:** ban dau dinh vi thu muc `pages/` bang duong dan
tuong doi `parents[3]` -> hong ngay khi test duoc chay tu thu muc khac (IndexError). Da
sua: suy ra tu vi tri module domain (da import duoc, khong can Qt) nen chay dung du test
o dau.

### Test
- `test_workflow_navigation_v323317.py` (8 test): tung khoa khop objectName that, moi
  khau tro toi trang co that, tep trang ton tai, khoa khong trung nhau.
Tong: **174 test PASS** (truoc 166, khong hoi quy).

### ⚠️ CHUA KIEM CHUNG DUOC
Khong co PySide6/man hinh -> chua chay thu giao dien. Da xac minh: logic ve thanh (6
trang thai), khop objectName, bien dich sach, xac minh tinh 8/8 diem noi day.
Ban can thu:
1. Mo app -> thanh tien do phai hien tren dau, dung khau cua du an dang mo.
2. Bam "Di toi" -> phai nhay dung trang.
3. Chay het quy trinh -> cac cham phai sang dan tu trai sang phai.
4. Du an da xuat ban -> vao Thu vien, nut "Xem phim da xuat" phai BAT va mo duoc phim.
5. Doi ten/di chuyen tep da xuat -> nut phai TAT (khong bam duoc).

### Trang thai ke hoach hoan thien
Ca 3 viec de xuat o v3.23.316 DA XONG. Quy trinh gio khep kin tu dau den cuoi:
    Trich xuat -> Bien tap -> Dich -> TTS -> Xuat ban -> xem lai o Thu vien
voi chi dan buoc tiep theo o moi khau.

## [3.23.316] — 🔗 Hoan thien QUY TRINH: khep kin vong lam viec + goi y buoc tiep theo

### PHAN TICH TONG QUAN (dua tren doc ma nguon, khong phong doan)

**Luong du lieu giua cac trang — DA DAY DU ✅**
    Trich xuat --(extraction_completed)--> Bien tap (tu nap + luu du an)
    Bien tap   --(provider)--> Dich, TTS
    Dich       --(push_to_editor + persist)--> Bien tap
    TTS        --(tts_completed)--> luu du an + cache cho Xuat ban
    Xuat ban   --(3 provider)--> lay tu 3 trang tren
Ket luan: phan "ong nuoc" giua cac trang hoat dong dung.

**Trang thai du an — CO LO HONG ⚠️**
WorkflowStage co 5 khau nhung:
  * `EDITED` **KHONG CHO NAO GHI** — gia tri chet trong enum, Thu vien khong bao gio
    hien "Da chinh sua".
  * **KHONG co moc KET THUC** — quy trinh dung o TTS_DONE. Nhin Thu vien khong biet
    phim nao da xuat ban xong.
  * Trang Xuat ban (v3.23.315) khong ghi gi vao du an.

**Huong dan nguoi dung — THIEU HAN ❌**
  * Grep toan bo `presentation/`: KHONG co bat ky goi y "buoc tiep theo" nao.
  * `_on_page_changed` chi lam mot viec: preload OCR. Khong dan dat quy trinh.
  * Nguoi dung phai TU BIET thu tu Trich xuat -> Bien tap -> Dich -> TTS -> Xuat ban.

## [3.23.315] — 📤 Trang XUẤT BẢN + thuyết minh có ducking (giữ nhạc/tiếng động)

### 1. TRA LOI CAU HOI: co ha tieng goc khi them TTS khong?
**Truoc ban nay: KHONG.** Che do DUB_AUDIO (v3.23.314) chi THEM track TTS rieng — khong
tron, khong ha tieng goc. Trinh phat chi phat mot track.

**Nay co che do moi VOICE_OVER** — dung ky thuat chuan cua thuyet minh phat thanh:
lay chinh giong thuyet minh lam **tin hieu dieu khien** (sidechain) cho bo nen dat tren
tieng goc. Thuyet minh noi -> tieng goc ha; im -> tieng goc dang lai.

=> **Nhac va tieng dong nen VAN CON**, chi nho di dung luc can. Da do thuc nghiem.

**GIOI HAN PHAI NOI RO:** bo nen ha **TOAN BO** tieng goc (ca nhac lan thoai goc), chu
KHONG tach rieng thoai. Nghia la thoai goc van nghe duoc nho ben duoi. Muon xoa HAN
thoai goc ma giu nguyen nhac/tieng dong thi phai **tach nguon am bang AI** (Demucs, MIT,
can torch ~2GB). Chua tich hop; da ghi chu san trong ma nguon. Neu ban bat WhisperX thi
da co torch, luc do them Demucs la re.

### 2. DO THUC NGHIEM 3 muc ducking
Do bang ffmpeg + FFT: nen 200Hz lien tuc, thuyet minh 1kHz chi noi 2s-4s -> tach duoc
tung nguon. Dò tham so tren 8 to hop nguong/ti le:
    nguong 0.020, ratio 12 -> ha  -7.2 dB
    nguong 0.010, ratio 12 -> ha -12.7 dB   <- dai chuan thuyet minh
    nguong 0.005, ratio 12 -> ha -18.2 dB
Ban dau toi dat nguong 0.03 -> chi ha 4.0 dB (qua yeu). Da doi sang 0.01.

Phoi ra 3 muc de hieu thay vi tham so tho:
| Muc | Ha | Dung khi |
|---|---|---|
| Nhe | ~7 dB | phim nhieu nhac, muon giu nen ro |
| **Vua** (mac dinh) | ~13 dB | can bang — khuyen nghi |
| Manh | ~18 dB | uu tien nghe ro thuyet minh |
Xac minh lai: ca 3 muc do duoc **khop chinh xac** so ghi trong tai lieu (-7.2/-12.7/-18.2),
va nen KHONG bi tat han o ca 3 muc.

### 3. TRANG XUAT BAN (moi) — presentation/pages/publish_page.py
Dat o thanh dieu huong sau trang TTS, icon VIDEO, ten "Xuat ban".

**Bo cuc 3 the:**
1. **Nguon du lieu** — video goc / phu de da dich / giong thuyet minh.
   Moi hang co nut "Chon…" (mo hop thoai) va **"Lay tu app"** (tu dong lay tu cac trang
   truoc): video tu trang Bien tap, phu de tu trang Dich, giong doc tu trang TTS.
2. **Cach xuat** — 4 kieu, co goi y giai thich tung kieu; muc ha tieng goc (chi hien khi
   chon Thuyet minh); bo ma hoa (chi hien khi chon Phu de chay).
3. **Tep dich** — tu goi y ten (vd `phim_thuyetminh.mkv`), thanh tien do, nut Xuat/Huy.

**4 kieu xuat:**
| Kieu | Co che | Toc do |
|---|---|---|
| Phu de roi | mux track, `-c copy` | rat nhanh |
| Phu de chay | libass ve len hinh + ma hoa lai | cham |
| **Thuyet minh** | tron + ducking, hinh `copy` | nhanh |
| Tieng Viet track rieng | mux track | nhanh |

### 4. Lien thong du lieu giua cac trang
- `_remember_tts_wav_path`: cache duong dan WAV moi nhat tu tin hieu `tts_completed`.
- `_export_translated_subtitle_temp`: ffmpeg can mot TEP nhung trang Dich chi giu event
  trong bo nho -> tu xuat ra SRT tam trong `%TEMP%/SubtitlesExtractor_publish/`.
  Uu tien ban da dich; chua dich thi lay ban o Bien tap.
- Neu chua co du lieu -> bao RO can lam buoc nao truoc, thay vi bao loi chung chung.

### 5. Chay tren luong rieng (khong khoa UI)
`RenderVideoWorker` (QThread): ma hoa lai co the mat hang chuc phut. Tin hieu dung
`Qt.ConnectionType.QueuedConnection` (dung nguyen tac cua du an: KHONG chay code UI tren
luong worker). Co nut Huy — huy thi xoa tep dang ghi do.

### 6. Kiem chung
- **143 test PASS** (tang 10 test moi cho VOICE_OVER, khong hoi quy).
- 5 test do THUC bang ffmpeg: ca 3 muc ducking khop so do, nen khong bi tat han,
  giong thuyet minh xuat hien dung luc.
- Xac minh tinh main_window: 8/8 diem dang ky dung (import, tao trang, nav, 3 provider,
  cache wav, import Path).

### ⚠️ CHUA KIEM CHUNG DUOC
Moi truong nay khong co PySide6/man hinh nen **chua chay thu duoc giao dien trang Xuat
ban**. Phan LOGIC (dung lenh, ducking, worker) da do that. Ban can chay thu:

## [3.23.314] — 🎞️ TINH NANG MOI: xuat video hoan chinh (kem phu de / tieng Viet)

### Boi canh: tim khoang trong THAT thay vi them GPL cho co
Truoc khi them thu vien, toi ra soat ma nguon: grep TODO/FIXME/NotImplementedError ->
**khong co cai nao** (codebase da hoan thien). Nen doi cach: tim tinh nang con THIEU.

Ket qua: quy trinh ung dung la **trich phu de chay -> dich tieng Viet -> tong hop giong
doc**, nhung **buoc cuoi bi thieu**: app chi xuat duoc TEP PHU DE (.srt/.ass) va TEP AM
THANH roi. Khong co cach tao ra VIDEO HOAN CHINH de giao.
Day dung la thu ffmpeg GPL (v3.23.313) cho phep: libx264/libx265 + libass.

### Tinh nang moi: 3 kieu xuat
| Kieu | Co che | Toc do | Dung khi |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Ghep mem** | mux track phu de, `-c copy` | rat nhanh (khong ma hoa lai) | xem tren may tinh, bat/tat phu de duoc |
| **Chay vao hinh** | libass ve len khung + ma hoa lai | cham (tuy do dai) | xem tren TV/dien thoai khong ho tro phu de |
| **Thay tieng** | mux track tieng Viet TTS | nhanh (chi copy hinh) | ban long tieng Viet |

### Kien truc: tach DUNG LENH khoi CHAY LENH (SRP)
- `video_render_command.py` (243 dong) — **HAM THUAN** dung lenh ffmpeg. Kiem thu duoc
  day du, khong can ffmpeg.
- `ffmpeg_video_renderer.py` (151 dong) — chay tien trinh, bao tien do, huy duoc.

### Diem ky thuat da xu ly can than
1. **Thoat ky tu duong dan Windows cho bo loc `subtitles=`** — nguon loi kinh dien:
   ffmpeg dung `:` va `,` lam dau phan tach tham so bo loc, ma duong dan Windows LUON
   co `C:` va `\`. Quy tac: `\`->`/`, roi thoat `' [ ] , ;`, cuoi cung `:` -> `\:`.
   Vd: `C:\Videos\phim.ass` -> `C\:/Videos/phim.ass`
2. **Chon codec phu de theo dinh dang chua**: MKV -> `srt`, MP4 -> `mov_text`.
   Dinh dang khong chua duoc (vd .webm) -> bao loi RO RANG kem goi y, thay vi de ffmpeg
   that bai voi thong bao kho hieu.
3. **NVENC dung `-cq`, KHONG dung `-crf`** — truyen sai thang la khong co tac dung.
4. **Track tieng Viet dat TRUOC tieng goc** (`-map 0:v -map 1:a -map 0:a?`) de trinh
   phat tu chon lam mac dinh. Dau `?` o `0:a?` de video CAM khong lam ca lenh that bai.
5. **Chan ghi de len tep nguon** — se lam hong du lieu.
6. `-c:a copy` khi chay-vao-hinh: khong ma hoa lai tieng -> khong mat chat luong vo ich.

### KIEM CHUNG — CHAY FFMPEG THAT (khong chi kiem cau truc lenh)
Moi truong nay co ffmpeg 6.1.1 kem libx264/libx265/libass nen chay duoc dau-cuoi:
- Ghep mem MKV -> luong: video + audio + **subtitle(subrip, lang=vie)** ✓
- Ghep mem MP4 -> **mov_text, lang=vie** ✓
- Chay vao hinh libx264 va libx265 -> deu thanh cong, KHONG con track phu de (dung) ✓
- Thay tieng giu goc -> `[video, audio(vie), audio(None)]` — **tieng Viet dung dau** ✓
- Thay tieng bo goc -> 1 track ✓

**Xac minh phu de THUC SU duoc ve** (khong tin vao ma thoat 0):
Do tren video 720x1280 (dung dinh dang CJK drama doc):
    Diem anh chu: 7,142
    Vung: y=1173..1235 / 1280 (o DAY ✓), x=123..594 / 720 (CAN GIUA ✓)
    Nen luc khong co phu de: 0 diem (doi chung sach)

**Mot sai lam cua toi trong luc do:** ban dau dat nguong >230 tren nen testsrc nhieu mau
va ket luan "phu de KHONG duoc ve". Kiem lai moi thay: (a) thoi diem xuat hien khop
CHINH XAC khoang 0.5-2.5s cua phu de -> co che dung; (b) nguong do cua toi qua khat khe
sau khu rang. Da doi sang do tren nen den + nhieu nguong -> xac nhan dung.

### Test
`test_video_render_v323314.py` — 22 test PASS:
- Thoat duong dan: ky tu o dia, `\`->`/`, cac ky tu dac biet `' [ ] , ;`, dau cach.
- Cau truc lenh tung kieu; codec theo container; NVENC dung `-cq`; thu tu track.
- Kiem tra hop le: thieu nguon/phu de/am thanh, dich trung nguon, container khong ho tro.
- **3 test chay ffmpeg that** (tu bo qua neu may khong co ffmpeg/libass).
Doc tien do tu log ffmpeg: 6/6 truong hop dung, ke ca phan thap phan 1-3 chu so
(`.9` = 0.9s chu khong phai 0.009s).

Tong: **133 test PASS** (khong hoi quy).

### ⚠️ CHUA LAM (co chu dinh)
Chua noi vao UI. Ly do: can ban quyet dinh dat o dau (tab Trinh sua? tab TTS? menu?) va
luong nguoi dung the nao. Loi goi san sang dung:

    from subtitles_extractor.infrastructure.video.ffmpeg_video_renderer import render_video

## [3.23.313] — 🔓 Phuc hoi not cac thu vien bi loai vi license + SUA MOT LOI THAT

Ra soat HE THONG (grep dau vet "THUONG MAI"/"thay GPL" trong toan bo ma nguon) thay 6
cho tung bi thay the vi license. Duoi day la ket qua xu ly tung cho.

### 1. 🔴 SUA LOI THAT do chinh v3.23.307 cua toi gay ra
`gemini_video_context.py` dung `libx264` lam phuong an CPU khi khong co NVENC:
    dong 703: "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", ...
Nhung ban ffmpeg **LGPL** toi tich hop o v3.23.307 co `--disable-libx264`.
**Hau qua:** tren may KHONG co GPU NVIDIA, nen chunk video gui Gemini se THAT BAI.
Toi da bo sot: luc do chi kiem license, khong doi chieu encoder ma code THUC SU goi.

**Da sua:** doi sang ban ffmpeg **GPL** (`--extra-version=20260724`):
| Encoder | LGPL (cu) | GPL (nay) |
|---|---|---|
| h264_nvenc (GPU) | ✓ | ✓ |
| libx264 (CPU) | ✗ THIEU | ✓ |
| libx265 (CPU, nen tot hon) | ✗ | ✓ |
| libopenh264 | ✓ | ✓ |
Loi phu: libx265 nen nho hon -> **upload chunk len Gemini nhanh hon** (dung van de ban
tung neu o phien truoc).
Da xac minh bang cach doc chuoi cau hinh nhung trong binary, khong doan.

### 2. qfluentwidgets: phuc hoi duoc, KHONG phai sua 15 noi goi
Phat hien quan trong: `fluent_compat` duoc viet **tuong thich API** voi qfluentwidgets
(co ca ghi chu "giu ten API qfluentwidgets" trong ma nguon). Nen chi can doi backend.
- `fluent_compat/__init__.py` gio phan giai **theo TUNG KY HIEU**: co trong
  qfluentwidgets thi dung, thieu thi lui ve ban Qt thuan -> KHONG BAO GIO ImportError.
  (Nhap ca khoi se vo neu qfluentwidgets thieu mot ten, vd `GroupBox` la component
  rieng cua du an.)
- Bat bang: `set SUBEXT_USE_QFLUENTWIDGETS=1`
- **Mac dinh TAT** — vi ban Qt thuan dang chay on va dat WCAG 2.1, con giao dien la thu
  hong thi thay ngay. Khong thich thi bo bien la ve nguyen trang, KHONG can build lai.
- Da xac minh tinh: 31 ten trong __all__ deu duoc dinh nghia, KHONG mat API cu nao
  (chi them `active_backend()`); logic chon backend da kiem qua 5 gia tri bien.

### 3. Kiem tra cai bay: co "co tat pedalboard" nao con bat khong?
Lo ngai: neu con co tat thi viec cai pedalboard o v3.23.312 la VO ICH. Da kiem:
`SUBEXT_DISABLE_PEDALBOARD` la **opt-in** (mac dinh khong dat) va KHONG co cho nao tu
dat no. => pedalboard hoat dong binh thuong. Da don ghi chu "build THUONG MAI" con sot.

### 4. Cong cu kiem license: doi NGU NGHIA cho dung dinh huong
Truoc: GPL -> "CANH BAO, hay thay ban LGPL" (khong con dung).
Nay: GPL -> "ⓘ DUNG CHU DICH (du an la ma nguon mo)" + nhac nghia vu kem ma nguon.
**Chi `nonfree` moi bi chan** — vi ban nonfree KHONG duoc phan phoi lai duoi bat ky hinh
thuc nao, ke ca kem ma nguon. Day la phan biet quan trong ma truoc day gop chung.
Ket qua: ma thoat 0 (truoc la 1) du dang dung ffmpeg GPL + libmpv GPL.

### 5. NHUNG THU VAN KHUYEN KHONG DOI (giu nguyen ket luan v3.23.312)
- **PySide6 -> PyQt6**: khong. PySide6 la binding CHINH THUC cua Qt Company, ngang tinh
  nang. Doi = churn thuan tuy.
- **charset_normalizer -> chardet**: khong. charset_normalizer nhan dien ma hoa CHINH XAC
  HON (quan trong voi CJK). Day la lua chon KY THUAT, khong phai vi license.
- **libmpv**: giu lam trinh phat mac dinh (hwdec, vo=gpu-next). Gio hop le ve license.
- **edge_tts_subprocess.py**: giu co che cach ly subprocess. Ban dau lam de tranh lan
  GPL, nhung no VAN CO ICH: edge-tts loi/treo mang khong lam sap app chinh.

### 6. Trang thai license cuoi cung
| Thanh phan | License | Ghi chu |
|---|---|---|
| ffmpeg (vendor) | **GPL v3** | co libx264/libx265/nvenc |
| libmpv (vendor) | **GPL v2+** | trinh phat mac dinh |
| pedalboard | GPL v3 | keo gian thoi gian chat luong cao |
| edge-tts | GPL v3 | giong neural |
| qfluentwidgets | GPL v3 | tuy chon, mac dinh tat |
=> Toan bo tac pham theo **GPL**: phan phoi phai KEM MA NGUON. Dung ca nhan thi khong.

### 7. Kiem chung
- compileall sach; spec cu phap OK; batch ngoac can bang.
- 111 test PASS (khong hoi quy).
- Da mo phong ca 2 nhanh cua SUBEXT_USE_QFLUENTWIDGETS va SUBEXT_ENABLE_WHISPERX.
- Xac minh tinh: khong mat API nao trong fluent_compat.

### ⚠️ CHUA KIEM CHUNG DUOC
- Khong cai duoc PySide6/qfluentwidgets trong moi truong nay -> **chua chay thu giao dien
  qfluentwidgets**. Day la ly do de mac dinh TAT.
- Chua chay thu ffmpeg GPL tren Windows (chi doc metadata).

### Buoc tiep theo cho ban
1. Build lai. Kiem log co: `[spec] Đã gom gói nâng cấp: pedalboard/edge_tts/...`
2. **Quan trong**: thu tinh nang "ngu canh video khi dich" tren may KHONG co GPU NVIDIA
   (hoac dat SUBEXT_FORCE_CPU=1) -> phai chay duoc, xac nhan libx264 da co.
3. Muon thu giao dien Fluent goc:
       pip install PySide6-Fluent-Widgets
       set SUBEXT_USE_QFLUENTWIDGETS=1
   Chay thu; khong thich thi bo bien la xong.

## [3.23.312] — 🚀 Bo rang buoc license thuong mai: bat cac thu vien CHAT LUONG CAO NHAT

Ban quyet dinh KHONG thuong mai hoa ung dung nua. Ban nay go rang buoc
"chi dung LGPL/Apache/MIT/ISC" va bat cac goi tot hon.

### 1. DA BAT (deu co adapter + fallback SAN trong ma nguon — chi can cai)
| Goi | License | Vai tro | Truoc day loai vi |
|---|---|---|---|
| pedalboard | GPL v3 | Keo gian thoi gian chat luong cao (nhan Rubber Band) | LICENSE |
| edge-tts | GPL v3 | Giong neural Microsoft (adapter 127KB da viet day du) | LICENSE |
| fastembed | Apache 2.0 | Nhung ngu nghia cho Bo nho Dich | DUNG LUONG |
| scikit-learn | BSD-3 | Gom cum DBSCAN cho tu dong do ROI | DUNG LUONG |

**Diem quan trong:** ma nguon DA san sang, khong phai sua gi:
- `tts/time_stretch.py` da xep hang pedalboard > librosa > WSOLA, va da co san canh bao
  "nen manh >1.6x ma thieu pedalboard -> formant tan thanh tieng gio".
- `video/bbox_analyzer.py` da `try: from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN` voi co HAS_SKLEARN.
Cai vao la TU DONG nang cap chat luong.

### 2. WhisperX: tuy chon bat/tat (khong ep moi ban build)
Da co adapter day du (40KB). Mac dinh VAN TAT — nhung ly do gio la DUNG LUONG chu khong
con la license: whisperx keo theo torch + CUDA rieng (~3GB) trong khi bundle da ~9GB.
De bat:
    set SUBEXT_ENABLE_WHISPERX=1
    build_windows.bat
Spec doc bien nay: bat -> gom whisperx+torch; tat -> loai nhu cu. Da kiem chung ca 2 nhanh.

### 3. Cong kiem license -> chuyen thanh GHI NHAN (khong chan build)
Van chay `tools/check_media_licenses.py` de GHI LAI thanh phan dang dung. Huu ich vi
GPL yeu cau kem ma nguon + giu thong bao ban quyen khi phan phoi.

### 4. THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md: ghi ro he qua phap ly
Da them canh bao dau tai lieu: khi phan phoi ban co kem thanh phan GPL (libmpv,
pedalboard, edge-tts) thi TOAN BO tac pham phai phat hanh theo GPL — phai KEM MA NGUON.
Dung ca nhan/noi bo thi khong phat sinh nghia vu nay.

### 5. ⚠️ NHUNG THU TOI KHUYEN **KHONG** DOI (va ly do)
"Bo rang buoc license" KHONG dong nghia moi goi GPL deu xin hon. Cu the:

- **PySide6 -> PyQt6: KHONG nen.** PySide6 la binding CHINH THUC cua Qt Company, tinh
  nang ngang PyQt6. Doi lai = churn thuan tuy, rui ro cao, loi ich bang 0.
- **fluent_compat -> qfluentwidgets: KHONG nen luc nay.** UI hien tai da chay on va
  dat WCAG 2.1. Refactor toan bo UI de doi lay giao dien tuong duong la danh doi xau.
  Neu sau nay muon, nen lam RIENG mot phien, tung trang mot, co anh so sanh truoc/sau.
- **charset_normalizer -> chardet: KHONG nen.** charset_normalizer khong chi "an toan
  license" ma con NHAN DIEN MA HOA CHINH XAC HON chardet (quan trong voi phu de CJK).
  Day la lua chon KY THUAT dung, khong phai lua chon vi license. Giu shim.
